# Level 4 · Language From Scratch

Models do not read words. They read integers, predict the next one, and learn that words used in similar places mean similar things. You build a byte-pair tokenizer, a counting language model with a perplexity score, and word vectors from nothing but co-occurrence counts. Large language models are these three ideas at enormous scale.
